symptom: Vacation last-minute deals returned tomorrow before 14:00 and the shared date boundary changed only at 14:01.
expected_behavior: Use today's Israel date before 14:00 and tomorrow's Israel date from 14:00:00 onward, with a visible rail refresh at the boundary.
environment: VII cumulative candidate branch release/v791-complete-20261104 at ecd46ee7 before repair, local Node 22 tests, Asia/Jerusalem winter and summer clocks.

steps: Call todayDealsVisible and dealClockKey at 14:00:00 and 14:00:59 Israel time.
Inspect the home-deals client URL across the boundary.
reproduction.evidence: Before repair, 13:59:59 returned the following day, 14:00:00 and 14:00:59 retained the today clock key, and the HTTP URL had no clock dimension.

observations.observation: homeDealDates used a fixed offset of one whenever the period weekday was null.
todayDealsVisible treated 14:00 through 14:00:59 as today and excluded 00:00 through 00:00:59.
The component scope changed with clock.key but its HTTP URL did not, allowing browser or edge response caching to reuse the pre-cutoff request URL.

hypotheses.mechanism: Hard-coded date and cutoff offsets, plus a time-invariant request URL, encode the wrong business boundary.
hypotheses.prediction: Pure helper calls reproduce tomorrow before 14:00 and a today key at 14:00 without any supplier I/O.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run homeDealDates, todayDealsVisible and dealClockKey at 13:59:59, 14:00:00 and 14:00:59.
hypotheses.result: Prediction observed exactly before repair; after repair 13:59:59 uses today and 14:00:00 uses tomorrow with a new URL clock value.

hypotheses.mechanism: The supplier API returns a wrong stay date.
hypotheses.prediction: The defect requires a supplier response and date helpers are correct in isolation.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Reproduce using only local date helpers without a network call.
hypotheses.result: The defect reproduced without any supplier request, so supplier data is not the cause.

hypotheses.mechanism: A daylight-saving conversion error shifts the local hour.
hypotheses.prediction: Boundary behavior differs between +02:00 and +03:00 dates.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Run the boundary matrix on winter, summer and both 2026 Israel transition dates.
hypotheses.result: The same exact 14:00 boundary passes on all four dates, so the formatter is not the causal defect.

fix.change: Use firstDealDate for the last-minute period, define today as 00:00 through 13:59 Israel time, and add dealClockKey to the home-deals request URL so the response identity changes at 14:00.
fix.evidence: Focused tests pass 58/58, the two discovered family regressions were updated to the explicit rule and pass 10/10, the full suite passes 1958 with zero failures, and pnpm build succeeds.

regression_checks.check: Exact Israel boundary and DST matrix
Event, spa and holiday shared consumers
